stage: Source authoring only; final explain-check gate is reported separately at handoff.

research.scopeReview: Read the complete sealed report and research.json, including all eight claims, limitations, evidence visibility and contradictory FAQ. Principles and external-voice/fit scope answer this question; sources read 2026-09-14 are adequate for this established-mechanism explanation. No new web research or product performance assertions.
research.integrity: Copied report.md and research.json were statically verified byte-identical to examples/anc/research. Authority was not modified.

designBrief.reader: Curious nonexpert asking why aircraft rumble fades while speech may remain.
designBrief.argument: Equal opposite pressure changes must meet at the ear; shorter cycles tighten error tolerance, speech spans different components, and fit changes the acoustic boundary.
designBrief.composition: Editorial title and numbered margin rail; one local acoustic/control schematic per language; one shared-scale pressure experiment; qualitative speech comparison rows; practical conclusion. Not a fixed card grid.
designBrief.responsibilities: Prose supplies causal bridges. Solid/dashed arrows distinguish sound from signals. The slider isolates phase mismatch in an ideal equal-amplitude single-tone one-location model, not real delay or perceived loudness.
designBrief.hostConstraints: Updated dist Aha guides plus invoked web-artifacts-builder. Clawpilot variables and Segoe UI/Aptos/Calibri stack retained; compatible theme detection is the first script and honors explicit light/dark. This is not evidence of Aha-only aesthetic generation.
designBrief.responsiveIntent: 18px body, fluid heading hierarchy. SVG labels are 16 units; 680px ear diagram and 400px plot retain minimum widths inside named keyboard-focusable local scroll regions. Grid children can shrink without widening the page. No motion.
designBrief.resources: Original inline SVG/CSS/classic JS only; no external assets, downloaded fonts, copied third-party code or media. System-font substitution, especially Chinese glyph fallback, requires browser review.

editorialReview.english: Independently reread the complete English source: headings, body, SVG titles/descriptions/labels, citations, control labels, initial feedback and every dynamic feedback branch. Named pressure sources, opposing signs, equal amplitudes and ear location are explicit; phase and fundamental frequency are introduced.
editorialReview.chinese: Independently reread the complete Chinese source including accessibility and dynamic strings. Natural Chinese phrasing preserves the explanation without relying on an English sentence template. Source names remain proper nouns; explanatory citation wording is localized.
editorialReview.parity: Compared both branches against the same claims after independent reads. Same sources, ideal assumptions, 0/60/180-degree meanings, normalized ratios, conditional speech reduction, fit/mode distinction and product-measurement gap. Steadiness headings now make the same bounded claim.
revisions: Ear-location note now explains peaks/troughs arriving differently instead of using undefined phase terminology.
Frequency paragraph names the speaker/noise relationship at the ear, explains position error relative to wavelength, and bounds worsening with frequency to the small-error range.
Voiced-speech row defines fundamental frequency before discussing harmonics.
Model grid children use min-width:0 to contain local SVG scrolling.
editorialReview.boundary: Agent source-level editorial judgment, not learner testing, rendered visual inspection or independent human acceptance.

claimReview.finding: Supported within the linear pressure approximation; conceptual hybrid diagram, not universal topology or cabin-wide silence.
Bounded mathematical inference. Equal unit amplitudes, one frequency and one point; residual peak ratio 2|sin(delta/2)|. Real amplitude/path/bandwidth/noise/stability limits stay beside the model.
Low-frequency favorability is conditional. Speech comparison is qualitative, not a spectrum, cutoff or intelligibility measurement. Some voice components may be reduced.
Physical barrier and fit complement active pressure addition; no equal split or universal crossover. Mode checks are practical expectations, not diagnostics certification.
Preserves the rejection of SoundGuys' categorical voice FAQ; its related pages are one editorial lineage, not independent replications.

omissions.claimLevel: None: all eight claims are covered in both languages; artifact.json omissions is intentionally empty.
omissions.detailLevel: Omit the dossier's hypothetical 0.10ms numeric illustration, detailed topology taxonomy and research discovery log to keep focus. No product ranking, dB curve, hearing-protection assertion, measured loudness or word-recognition prediction.

performedStaticChecks.method: Read source as text; Python standard-library HTMLParser and assertions, without executing authored HTML/JS.
performedStaticChecks.result: Passed: 48 unique IDs, reference targets present, two localized section roots, two 0..180 step-1 inputs initially 0, two inline classic scripts, no external resource elements, all 12 coverage locators present, unchanged report/ledger copies.
performedStaticChecks.codeReview: Interaction queries are scoped to each data-model figure, use textContent/output.value and inert SVG path attributes, and do not measure hidden geometry. No network/storage/media APIs, eval, imports, workers or external scripts. No language/theme UI authored.
performedStaticChecks.limits: Static inspection does not verify browser behavior, CSS contrast, font coverage, clipping, screen-reader announcements or rendering.
